title: Ceviche Style Smoky Tofu
description: A vegetarian twist on traditional ceviche, using marinated smoky tofu as the protein.

ingredients.name: Mixed vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers, onions, and tomatoes

instructions: Cut the smoky tofu into small cubes.
In a separate bowl, mix together the light soy sauce and Malaysian chili sauce.
Add the mixed vegetables to the marinade and stir well.
Combine the tofu and marinade mixture, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Just before serving, sprinkle the fresh cilantro on top and garnish with additional vegetables if desired.
